Examples.Title: Clean up unused images
Examples.Description: Remove unused sandbox image versions. Versions referenced by active deployments are preserved.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Delete a sandbox image
Examples.Description: Delete the image repository and all its tags. Reject deletion if any version is referenced by an active deployment. Return the deleted image.
Examples.Code:
### Delete a sandbox image
# @name DeleteImage
DELETE {{host}}/v1/sandboxes/images/{{image_name}}?team_id={{team_id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
X-Team-Id: {{X-Team-Id}}
Accept: application/json

Examples.Title: Get image build logs
Examples.Description: Return one page of logs from the latest recorded build of this image, including failed builds, newest first. Logs may take a short time to appear. Defaults to the last 24 hours; the requested time range must not exceed 7 days. Keep start_time and end_time fixed when paging with offset. A new build changes the log source; this endpoint does not retrieve a historical build by ID. While a new upload is waiting to start, logs may still refer to the preceding build. Older builds without a recorded environment use image-level build logs within the requested time range.
Examples.Code:
### Get image build logs
# @name GetImageBuildLogs
GET {{host}}/v1/sandboxes/images/{{image_name}}/logs?team_id={{team_id}}&start_time={{start_time}}&end_time={{end_time}}&limit=100&offset=0
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
X-Team-Id: {{X-Team-Id}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Build logs in the requested time range. An empty array means no logs are available in that range.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: List sandbox images
Examples.Description: Return one cursor-paginated page of image repository summaries. Tags are listed separately. Pages can be empty when non-sandbox repositories are excluded; follow pagination.cursor while pagination.has_more is true. Prefix search forces ascending name order.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: List built-in sandbox images
Examples.Description: Return the built-in sandbox images, the same for every team, so no team is selected. Use the image field directly as the image of a sandbox, without building or pushing it. Hidden and upcoming images are excluded.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Push a sandbox image
Examples.Description: With image supplied, import the registry image asynchronously. Otherwise return an upload URL for a ZIP source archive containing its Dockerfile and build context. The uploaded ZIP archive must not exceed 5 GB. Processing starts after upload. No sandbox is created. Poll the image until BUILT or FAILED.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create a sandbox
Examples.Description: Create a sandbox with an optional client-provided name, generated by the server when omitted. The request waits briefly for deployment, then returns the created resource. Deployment may continue after the response; inspect status to determine readiness. Names belonging to failed or terminated sandboxes can be reused; an active sandbox reserves its name. Every field is optional. The server applies image and memory defaults; SDKs should omit fields the caller did not set. A request with no body creates a sandbox from baseten/base-image:latest, the built-in image with the sandbox execution API ready to use, with 4096 MB of memory. It is available directly; no image build, push, or GET /v1/sandboxes/images is needed. Use the returned url to execute commands with your authentication token as a Bearer token, not your Baseten API key.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Get sandbox configuration
Examples.Description: Return available Carbon-compatible sandbox regions. Configuration is the same for every team, so no team is selected. Only enabled regions supporting Carbon are returned. This describes regional capability, not the runtime selected for a particular team or sandbox. Region configuration is cached for up to 30 seconds.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: List sandboxes
Examples.Description: Return a cursor-paginated page of sandboxes. Terminated sandboxes are hidden by default.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Update a sandbox
Examples.Description: Partially update configuration. Omitted fields remain unchanged; supplied arrays and maps replace their previous values. Structured objects update only supplied fields. The name, memory, network, region, image, and ports are immutable after creation. Supplying any of these fields returns 400, including unchanged, empty, or null values.
Examples.Code:
### Update a sandbox
# @name UpdateSandbox
PATCH {{host}}/v1/sandboxes/instances/{{sandbox_name}}?team_id={{team_id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
X-Team-Id: {{X-Team-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "lifecycle": {
    "expiration_policies": [
      {
        "action": "DELETE",
        "type": "TTL_IDLE",
        "value": "24h"
      },
      {
        "action": "DELETE",
        "type": "TTL_MAX_AGE",
        "value": "7d"
      },
      {
        "action": "DELETE",
        "type": "DATE",
        "value": "2026-09-23T21:26:58Z"
      }
    ],
    "terminated_retention": "24h"
  },
  "envs": [
    {
      "name": "NODE_ENV",
      "secret": false,
      "value": "production"
    },
    {
      "name": "PORT",
      "secret": false,
      "value": "3000"
    }
  ],
  "external_id": "api-review-20260916-001",
  "labels": {
    "env": "development",
    "project": "api-review",
    "team": "engineering",
    "revision": "2"
  }
}
